verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI agent platform, but the evidence shows Gumloop as a cloud service: hosted MCPs and the code sandbox run on Gumloop's infrastructure. The gumloop-py local installer is a client SDK/tool, not a deployable copy of the core platform. No evidence shows the core product can be self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
